title: Relic GUI
description: Overhaul GUI to look more stylish with mod integration: Cobblemon, Farmer's Delight, AppleSkin and many more!
body:
![Relic GUI Label](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1536725b310389275d6e6019163aacb2dc0d708.png)

**INFO:** It's not perfect but I like it, and I hope u will like it too. Pack is mostly for **1.21.5+** but it should work fine on older versions with [OptiGUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/optigui) Installed, also personally I suggest to install [OptiGUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/optigui) anyway due to helping with some containers like barrels and some containers from mods.

![Separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34b9a63d4caeeb6da3d1819f6764cd1ab5e4c045.png)

**CURRENT TEXTURES:** The pack currently contains textures for all or mostly Vanilla GUI, also includes a wide range of GUI from mods and would include more and more as well in the future.

**MORE INFO:**
  - Feel free to reach out to me on [Twitter](https://x.com/TheSniezekMC) for any errors, ideas, or just to write.
  -  I'm planning to make as much compatibility with mods as I can, and I’d also love to hear y’all’s suggestions on Twitter  ~~_or Discord if you manage to find me_~~.
  -  Ngl I won't promise that it works correctly on version below 1.21.5 but it should though, will test it someday or you can write to me on social media ([Twitter](https://x.com/TheSniezekMC)) for any errors.
 - **License ARR**, you can't modify or reupload any of my assets or claim them as your own… Well, at least not without asking. I'm a nice dude, just talk to me, man — I’m not biting.
